import re

content = note['content']

shares = {}
for line in content.splitlines():
    line=line.strip()
    if not line.startswith('-'): 
        continue
    m=re.match(r'-\s*(.*?)\s*=>\s*\$\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)', line)
    if m:
        name=m.group(1).strip()
        amt=float(m.group(2))
        shares[name]=shares.get(name,0.0)+amt

print('shares parsed:', shares)
print('count shares:', len(shares))

def venmo_matches_by_email(query_email: str):
    # Search all pages for venmo users matching this email
    matches=[]
    i=0
    while True:
        page = apis.venmo.search_users(access_token=ven_access, query=query_email, page_index=i, page_limit=20)
        if not page:
            break
        matches.extend(page)
        i += 1
    # Keep only exact email matches
    exact=[m for m in matches if m.get('email')==query_email]
    return exact if exact else matches
